name: depthwizard-frontend
description: M1 viewer scaffold. Currently a zero-build vanilla Three.js page (frontend/index.html + frontend/src/viewer.js) that loads Three.js from a CDN via an import map -- no npm install required to run it. This package.json is a placeholder for the eventual move to a bundled React + @react-three/fiber app (see README.md, 'Migrating to React') once real npm registry access is available to build and verify it.
